name: chart-maker
description: Turns data you paste into a chart, or a process or structure you describe into a diagram, in a form the chat can show. Charts come back as a text bar chart you can see inline, a table, and a self-contained SVG picture you download as an html file and open in a browser. Diagrams come back as Mermaid source plus a plain-text outline. Every number is parsed from your data in code: it never invents, fetches or edits data, and it writes nowhere. Change it with "line chart", "top 5", "sort by name" or "add a rollback step". Not for explaining or forecasting data, statistics, general questions or drawing logos and illustrations.

skills.name: Make a chart or diagram
skills.description: A chart from pasted data (CSV, TSV, a markdown table, label: value lines or JSON) or a diagram of a process, sequence, hierarchy, timeline or relationships you describe. Charts: inline text chart, table and a downloadable SVG; diagrams: Mermaid source and an outline. Numbers come only from your data.
examples: Bar chart of signups by channel: <paste CSV>
Diagram our onboarding: signup, verify email, choose plan, pay, welcome
